simulator.title: Routing simulator
simulator.description: Inspect OpenAI Chat routing from local metadata. No provider request is sent.
simulator.inputHint: OpenAI Chat Completions body only; up to 64 KiB including the envelope, nesting at most 32 levels.
simulator.optOut: Disable Token Saver for this inspection
simulator.invalidJson: Enter valid JSON. The draft was not sent.
simulator.tooLarge: Simulation JSON including the envelope must be at most 64 KiB.
simulator.empty: Run a request to see its local routing candidates and reasons.
simulator.stale: Result is stale: the draft or opt-out changed. Run again to inspect the current input.
simulator.outcomeCandidate: A local first-dispatch candidate exists. Provider success is not guaranteed.
simulator.outcomeBlocked: Current local rules block this route.
simulator.outcomeConditional: This plan depends on outcomes that were not executed.

simulator.reasonFusionJudge: Judge is conditional on panel answers; generated input was not executed.
simulator.reasonFusionSingleMember: A one-member fusion combo delegates to a plain request.

simulator.reasonModelResolved: Resolved using current model/provider precedence and capability rules.
simulator.reasonKeylessProvider: This provider does not require a saved account.
simulator.reasonAccountSelected: This account would be the local selection for this hypothetical branch.
simulator.reasonAccountFallback: This eligible account is a conditional alternative, not an executed attempt.
simulator.reasonAccountLocked: A live model or account-wide lock excludes this account.
simulator.reasonRouteRejected: A deterministic local rule rejects this branch; its code is shown below.
simulator.reasonInspectionLimit: A source or inspection limit prevents a definitive decision.
simulator.warningSnapshot: This is an inspection timestamp, not a reservation. Live requests can change the next selection.
simulator.warningCredentials: Credentials were not decrypted or refreshed. Eligibility does not certify that they are readable or valid.
